title: lambda-trim: Optimizing Function Initialization in Serverless Applications With Cost-driven Debloating
problem: In serverless FaaS platforms, Function Initialization (package import, module loading) accounts for more than 50% of the monetary cost of cold starts in real-world ML applications, yet existing optimization efforts focus on the container/VM startup phase rather than the Python initialization phase.
motivation: Serverless ML applications pay substantial billed cost for loading unused Python modules during cold starts, and this initialization overhead is the user's responsibility under current pricing models, making it a critical but neglected optimization target.
method: lambda-trim uses a three-stage automated pipeline: a static analyzer identifies the reachable module dependency graph for a given serverless function, a profiler specialized for the serverless pricing model (which accounts for both memory usage and wall-clock time as billing dimensions) quantifies the latency and cost contribution of each module, and a debloater removes redundant code paths and unused modules while preserving correctness. The optimized application is directly deployable on standard serverless platforms without runtime changes.
key_novelty: Serverless-pricing-model-aware profiling that jointly optimizes for latency and memory (both billing dimensions) to prioritize debloating decisions, specifically targeting the Function Initialization phase.
contributions: Identification and quantification of Function Initialization as the dominant cold-start cost component in ML serverless workloads
Static analyzer for serverless Python module dependency graphs
Serverless-pricing-aware profiler that accounts for both latency and memory billing dimensions
Automated debloater producing deployable applications with reduced cold-start latency and cost

metrics.speedup: substantial reductions in cold-start latency (not quantified in abstract)
metrics.other: Function Initialization >50% of monetary cold-start cost in real-world ML applications

baselines: unoptimized serverless Python functions on FaaS platforms
limitations: Targets Python serverless applications only; correctness of debloating for dynamically imported modules or reflection-heavy code may require conservative handling.
primary_theme: Cost-driven Python debloating for serverless function initialization
